findings.evidence: `rg` finds `ideleFiniteCoord` and `ideleInfiniteCoord` at Basic.lean:159,165, while the only `@[ext] NumberField.IdeleGroup.ext` is Norm/Basic.lean:204 and its `hfin` premise is `IdeleGroup.toFiniteIdele ... x = ... y`; Range.lean:132-165 manually applies representation-level extensionality.
findings.fix: Move/strengthen `NumberField.IdeleGroup.ext` into `Ideles/Basic.lean` as an `@[ext]` theorem accepting equality of every infinite and finite coordinate, and update in-repository uses to the new canonical signature.
findings.issue: The public finite and infinite coordinate maps have no extensionality theorem stating that agreement at every coordinate determines an idele; the existing `NumberField.IdeleGroup.ext` in `Norm/Basic.lean:204` instead requires equality of the entire finite idele, and `Range.lean:132` consequently proves equality by unfolding through `Units.ext` and `Prod.ext`.

summary: The coordinate/assembly API lacks coordinatewise extensionality, forcing consumers to unfold the idele representation.
